findings.current: She never believed studying was the only path to success. Even when she saw my report card from high school, where I had scored a seven in every subject and hit the jackpot on a slot machine, she ended her lecture with a single short sentence.
findings.defect: The draft makes Taekyung literally hit a slot-machine jackpot in addition to receiving sevens. The source compares the row of sevens on his report card to a slot-machine jackpot.
findings.rationale: The jackpot is a visual joke about the repeated sevens, not a separate event in Taekyung’s past.
findings.replacement: She never believed studying was the only path to success. Even when she saw my high school report card—sevens in every subject, like a slot-machine jackpot—she ended her lecture with one short remark.
findings.source: 꼭 공부가 성공의 왕도라고 생각하지 않으셨고, 고등학교 시절 전 과목 7등급으로 슬롯머신 잭팟을 찍었던 성적표를 보시고도 짤막한 한 마디로 훈계를 마무리 지으셨다.

findings.current: When my mother saw her young daughter bound from head to toe with blue packing tape, she screamed. Then she beat the calves of her now-unfilial son with a back scratcher.
findings.defect: Rendering 효자손 only as “back scratcher” loses the explicit wordplay between the implement’s name, literally “filial son’s hand,” and the son who has become unfilial.
findings.rationale: The source directly contrasts 효자손 with 불효자가 된 아들; the cultural term and concise footnote preserve that joke.
findings.replacement:
When my mother saw her young daughter bound from head to toe with blue packing tape, she screamed. Then she beat the calves of her now-unfilial son with a *hyojason*.[^1]

[^1]: A Korean back scratcher whose name literally means “filial son’s hand.”
findings.source: 밧줄 대신 청테이프로 꽁꽁 묶인 어린 딸을 본 어머니는 비명을 질렀고, 효자손으로 불효자가 된 아들의 종아리를 때렸지만

findings.current: But I did not shed a single tear. I held firm with the stubbornness of an elementary school student.
findings.defect: The draft reverses the characterization: the source says his tenacity was unlike that of an elementary school student, not typical of one.
findings.rationale: 초등학생답지 않은 explicitly marks the resolve as unexpectedly strong for his age.
findings.replacement: But with a tenacity unusual for an elementary schooler, I didn’t shed a single tear.
findings.source: 나는 초등학생답지 않은 뚝심으로 눈물 한 방울 흘리지 않았다.

findings.current: Remembering the childhood innocence I had once thought impossible to fulfill, I opened my mouth.
findings.defect: “Fulfill childhood innocence” is unnatural and misidentifies 동심 here. Contextually, it is his childhood dream or childish ambition to bind Gulliver.
findings.rationale: The preceding paragraph explicitly identifies the remembered ambition; “childhood dream” preserves that referent and reads naturally.
findings.replacement: Remembering the childhood dream I’d thought I would never fulfill, I spoke.
findings.source: 나는 실현할 수 없으리라 생각했던 동심을 떠올리며 입을 열었다.

findings.current: The path carved by the purple Force containing the Zaha Divine Technique was instantly familiar.
findings.defect: The draft omits that the Zaha Divine Technique is called the essence of Huashan, losing the technique’s established sect significance.
findings.rationale: 화산파의 정수라 불리는 is an explicit description of the technique and should not be dropped.
findings.replacement: The path traced by the purple Force imbued with the Zaha Divine Technique, known as the essence of Huashan, was instantly familiar.
findings.source: 화산파의 정수라 불리는 자하신공이 담긴 자줏빛 강기가 그려 내는 궤적은 눈에 익은 것이었다.

findings.current: A thick, shameless insult about the bastard’s parentage accompanied a streak of flame that cut across the battlefield.
findings.defect: The draft omits the characterization that this crude insult is absurdly unbecoming of Jeok Cheongang’s age.
findings.rationale: 나이는 엿 바꿔 먹은 듯한 supplies the comic register shift: an elderly master is hurling a juvenile, vicious insult as though he has discarded his age.
findings.replacement: A streak of flame crossed the battlefield, accompanied by a filthy crack about the bastard’s parents that was wildly unbecoming of his age.
findings.source: 나이는 엿 바꿔 먹은 듯한 걸쭉한 패드립과 함께 전장을 가로지르는 한 줄기 불꽃.

findings.current: And only one person—Jin Taekyung—drew forth the last strength fading from the monster.
findings.defect: The draft makes Jin Taekyung the agent deliberately drawing strength out of the dragon. The source says his presence rouses the dragon’s own last reserves through its hatred of him.
findings.rationale: 진태경의 존재 is the stimulus that restores the monster’s strength, not an intentional action performed by Taekyung.
findings.replacement: And the presence of one man alone—Jin Taekyung—roused the monster’s last fading reserves of strength.
findings.source: 그리고 오직 한 사람, 진태경의 존재가 천천히 꺼져 가던 괴물의 마지막 힘을 끌어 올렸다.

summary: Several localized fidelity defects remain, including a metaphor turned into a literal event, omitted cultural and characterization cues, an omitted description of the Zaha Divine Technique, and altered agency in the dragon’s final effort.
